text: Alerts API accepts alerts and related data from external monitoring systems and groups them into cases
quote: The Alerts API allows you to send alerts from monitoring systems along with any data that might be relevant for working the alert. Hummingbird will group alerts into cases

text: Case API creates or updates cases that are not tied to monitoring alerts, such as complaints or incident reports
quote: For cases not tied to alerts from monitoring systems (e.g. customer review, incident reports, complaints, etc.)... Hummingbird provides a Case API for creating or updating cases.

text: APIs list cases and fetch case details for information retrieval or data syncing
quote: for information retrieval or data syncing, Hummingbird provides APIs for listing cases and fetching case information over API.

text: Case import API batch-creates many cases at once
quote: Hummingbird also supports batch creating cases over the case import API. This is preferable for use cases where it's desirable to create many cases all at once

text: Validates cases against a jurisdiction, files them, and monitors filing status
quote: allows you to validate cases against a given jurisdiction, file the case, and monitor the filing status.

text: Tracks a filing as it is batched, delivered to FinCEN, and processed by FinCEN
quote: you can track your filing as we batch it, deliver it to FINCEN, and when FINCEN processes it

text: Batch filing sends filings to FinCEN in batches instead of one at a time
quote: Batching Filing enables a filing organization to send filings to FinCEN in batches instead of one filing at a time.

text: Bulk-uploads attachments to a case's Files tab by drag and drop
quote: You can add one or more attachments (bulk import) in the Files tab from within a case... by dragging and dropping your file onto the page.

text: Views attachments and PDFs inside the app without downloading them
quote: you can view attachments and PDFs directly within Hummingbird without leaving the app -- simply click on the file

text: Associates files with CRM objects so documents appear wherever that person is viewed
quote: Hummingbird allows you to associate files with CRM objects. So, driver's licenses are available wherever that person is being viewed

text: Renames uploaded files from the file menu
quote: Click the pencil icon or choose "rename" from the kebab menu. Give the file a new name and confirm your intention.

text: Configuration setting can automatically add the official Financial Institution to manually created cases
quote: We can automatically add the "official" Financial Institution to manually created cases. This is a configuration setting

text: Organization settings manage profile information, narrative templates, API keys, and the login message
quote: Click on the Update Organization button... to update Profile Information, Narrative Templates, API Keys, and Login Message.

text: Automatic audit trail records all work done in the product
quote: Automatic audit trail: This feature ensures that you have comprehensive audits of all work that occurs in Hummingbird.

text: Exports detailed case information with one click
quote: Download case information: This feature allows you to export detailed case information with one-click.

text: Exports case data, including comments, for a selected time frame from report history
quote: navigating to Settings -> Reports -> History, and clicking the "Export" button. This will download case data for the time frame selected, including case comments.

text: Exports any table's data as a CSV download
quote: You can export data from a table you need by clicking on the Download icon in the upper right of each table. This initiates a CSV download.

text: Creates a pending periodic review that reopens a case automatically when it is due, typically after 90 days
quote: Hummingbird creates a "pending" review of the case that will automatically open when it's time to review the case again (typically 90 days).

text: @-mentions in case comments notify reviewers in-app and by email
quote: you could @-mention your selected reviewers in the Comments section and let them know... they'll receive a notification in-app and by email.

text: Supports peer approvals where the case assignee adds an approver, if the workflow allows it
quote: You must be the assignee of the case in order to add an approver, and the workflow must be configured to allow for peer approvals.

text: Configurable workflows can mirror an organization's compliance policies
quote: We can easily configure your Hummingbird account with workflows that mirror your policies. We built Hummingbird to easily integrate into your existing workflow

text: Automates routine work and moves cases between agents and the team while keeping decisions defensible
quote: It automates routine work, moves cases between agents and your team, and keeps every decision defensible.

text: Screens customers and dispositions alerts using customizable automation for onboarding, ongoing monitoring, and investigations
quote: Screen customers and disposition alerts more intelligently. Streamline your onboarding, ongoing monitoring, or ad-hoc investigations using customizable automation
